explanation: The merchant booked their gateway fees and GST input credit in receipt voucher RV-0002 by assuming a flat rate across all transactions. In reality, Razorpay charges per-method MDR, and UPI transactions carry 0% MDR. Specifically, out of 11 payments totaling ₹18,902.05, two UPI transactions amounting to ₹3,477.72 incurred ₹0.00 fee and GST, whereas the remaining card and wallet transactions incurred 2% MDR plus 18% GST. This caused the books to overstate the gateway fee by ₹22.30 and GST input credit by ₹4.03, resulting in a total discrepancy of ₹26.33.
evidence: Settlement UTR: 331627450189
Receipt voucher RV-0002 booked Gateway Fee of ₹330.79 and GST Input Credit of ₹59.54
Razorpay actual total fee charged: ₹308.49 across 11 payments (difference of ₹22.30)
Razorpay actual total GST on fee: ₹55.51 (difference of ₹4.03)
Compute fee breakdown shows UPI payments (₹3,477.72 gross, 2 payments) were zero-rated (0 MDR), while card and wallet payments were charged 2% MDR plus 18% GST
Combined unexplained delta between booked and actual figures equals ₹26.33 (₹22.30 fee + ₹4.03 GST)
recommended_action: Instruct the accounts team to stop using a flat fee assumption for gateway fee booking. Instead, import the per-transaction fee and tax breakdown from Razorpay settlement reports or adjust voucher RV-0002 to match the actual charged fee of ₹308.49 and GST of ₹55.51.

explanation: The merchant recorded receipt voucher RV-0018 for settlement UTR 640771585351 based on gross payments (₹12,118.22) minus fees and GST (₹33.87 total), arriving at a bank debit of ₹12,084.35. However, Razorpay also netted a customer refund of ₹5,944.24 (associated with order_1kA9C365MiLpOj and refund id rfnd_XUSPOeagAyw3vu, for which a credit note CN-0009 was booked earlier on 2026-08-19) out of this exact settlement cycle. Because the refund was netted from the bank payout, the actual cash received in the bank account was ₹6,140.11, creating a difference of ₹5,944.24 between the books and the actual bank credit.
evidence: Settlement UTR 640771585351 has gross payments of ₹12,118.22, fees of ₹28.70, tax of ₹5.17, and a netted refund of ₹5,944.24, resulting in a true reconstructed net bank credit of ₹6,140.11.

The merchant booked receipt voucher RV-0018 for settlement UTR 640771585351 with a Bank debit of ₹12,084.35 (gross ₹12,118.22 minus fee ₹28.70 minus tax ₹5.17), failing to deduct the ₹5,944.24 refund (rfnd_XUSPOeagAyw3vu / order_1kA9C365MiLpOj) that Razorpay netted out of this settlement cycle.

recommended_action: Adjust receipt voucher RV-0018 (or post a journal entry) to credit Razorpay Clearing / debit Bank for the refund amount of ₹5,944.24, reducing the recorded bank receipt from ₹12,084.35 to ₹6,140.11 to match the actual bank credit and reconcile the Razorpay clearing account.
